kind: SYNTHETIC timing estimates (no real data, no labels); real views may converge differently (MLP early stopping); one process under lra.sema, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1; cpu_s = process CPU time of the measuring process
fixture: lra.audit.synthetic_D (OSF_DEFENSE_FIT 15,434 / AUDIT_FIT 6,065 / INNER_SELECTION 2,235 / assessment 13,936 rows, P(S=1) = 0.68) + synthetic_release i8o64 (income 8 per class x 2, occupation 64 per class x 5 predicted classes + 1 reserved token; SEX-tilted 10%) and its synthetic_d1 (same tokens, learned-style q); FINAL slate (LR x5, MLP x4, HGB x4, DA_LR, DA_MLP) + cell readers {0.5, 1, 5}; the AUC- and CE-selected attackers refit at attacker seeds 0-2; three code families (code / token / prob); a temporary lra-named unit store with the registered 84-code composition bank (real registration and closure checks); token-only family with the cell readers only (L4b)

registered_control_limits.null: every view: held-out AUC_B <= 0.5 + 3.5 sd0 (sd0 = Mann-Whitney null sd on half B)
registered_control_limits.XOR: AUC_B(pair) > 0.75 and AUC_B(v1) <= null threshold and AUC_B(v2) <= null threshold
registered_control_limits.ROT_r1_ROT_r2: AUC_B(v_i) > 0.75 and AUC_B(pair) > 0.75 and serialisation exact
registered_control_limits.null_calibration: 5 permutations (seed CONTROL_SEED + 100 + rep); pass iff no exceedance of 0.5 + 3.5 sd0
registered_control_limits.realised_threshold_rule: the realised null threshold must equal the source's within 1e-12 (fixed split and permutation seeds on the same roles); otherwise a technical failure
registered_control_limits.plants_in_candidate_bank: never (in-memory / temporary-directory releases, never saved as units)

L4b.rule: the token-only DIAGNOSTIC family is audited with the exact token-identity cell readers only: CC_alpha{0.5, 1, 5} on tok_i and CCpair_alpha{0.5, 1, 5} on the exact tuple (INNER-selected unseen-tuple fallback), both ignore-the-other-recipient banks, the same dual AUC / CE selection (dpc.audit._select); inner: lra.audit.inner_family_cells; assessment: lra.audit.final_audit_cells
L4b.rationale: for a pure categorical input the per-cell readers are the direct finite-sample Bayes readers of the token; the FINAL slate on a one-hot of tokens is a regularised approximation of them; the family is diagnostic only
L4b.unchanged: the complete-interface family (primary, nominated and composed) and the probability-only family keep the full FINAL slate + cell readers
L4b.cost_before: full-slate token family 27.85 CPU-s per synthetic i8o64 unit (first timing run)

alias_cache: L5: exact view-fingerprint alias reuse within a seed (path recorded per family; bitwise identical to recomputation); opportunistic, no saving assumed in the estimates beyond the D1 token family

registered_slate_and_views.slate: the pinned source FINAL slate (smf.audit.final_slate(False): LR x5, MLP x4, HGB x4, DA_LR, DA_MLP) + finite categorical cell readers CC / CCpair with smoothing 0.5, 1, 5; fitted on AUDIT_FIT, AUC- and CE-selected separately on INNER_SELECTION, fixed orientation
registered_slate_and_views.nomination_view: COMPLETE interface only (family 'code': one-hot full token identity, decoded q_i, one-hot decision_i; pair = both interfaces, exact token tuples, both ignore-recipient banks); nomination, composition and every primary result
registered_slate_and_views.diagnostic_views: token-only (family 'token', exact-token cell readers only: L4b) and probability-only (family 'prob', full slate + value cells); reported, never nominated or composed
registered_slate_and_views.composition: SRC|U composes through the COMPLETE registered map/decoder bank: all 84 codes per seed (the prompt's 83 plus the registered CLASS|D1, role F R-1) before strongest-control and nominee selection; every source-winning composed reader frozen for the assessment (composed.freeze); closure refuses missing or stray units

inner_bank.reconciliation: prompt sec. 8: 88 configurations x 3 = 264 units; the registered CLASS|D1 addition (role F R-1) makes 89 x 3 = 267 (252 code + 6 source + 9 reference units); no arm is treated as an alias to save a unit

shuffled SEX: NULL (every registered control release and family)
confidence signal within the predicted c: CONF_r2 (token split by noisy S*, the b = 1 copy decodes to (1 - 0.05) q + 0.05 e_d: same decision; decisions-only audit reported)
distinct-token / same-probability leak: COLL_r2 (two token IDs, one decoded vector; the probability-only audit is reported and cannot see it)
coalition XOR: XOR (pair detects, each local view stays at the null)
source rotated signal: ROT_r2 on the continuous U, RAW-J and E interfaces (Haar rotation of a 1e-6 noisy-S* column; serialisation exact)
real_data_controls.plan: control_plan(): codes U|DIRECT-TASK|i8o64, U|JOINT|i8o64|l0.1, U|CLASS|i1o1, U|JOINT|i8o64|l0.1|D1, U|K-JOINT-PAIR|i8o64|D1 (NULL + CONF + COLL + XOR each); sources U, RAW-J (NULL + ROT); references E (NULL + ROT), F, F0 (NULL); NULL_CALIBRATION x5
real_data_controls.consequence: any failed control is a GLOBAL technical failure: lra.eval_lock refuses the lock and lra.assess refuses the opening (finding F13); never evidence of privacy

d0_reuse_decision: RECOMPUTE: the admitted cbp inner audits lack the token-only and probability-only families, so the exact parity rule fails; all 81 D0 code and 9 reference inner units are recomputed (aud__ namespace); cbp_parity compares the recomputed primary family with the admitted cbp record

bank.codes_note: 84 registered codes per seed (lra.run.code_ids()): D0 27 (DIRECT-TASK, FINE-TASK, CLASS-ONLY i1o1, 24 privacy maps), D1 fixed-map 27 (the same 27 maps incl. CLASS|D1, role F R-1; same tokens as D0, learned q), new fits 30 (C-TASK, 24 weighted, 5 constrained); every code at most 8 / 64 states per predicted class (i8o64 shapes). Each code inner unit audits three families (code primary + token-only + probability-only diagnostics); a D1 unit reuses its D0 map's token family (L5)

assessment.note: upper count of locked labels per seed (lra.eval_lock.scored_labels): <= 17 codes (P*, N*, J*, T*, C*, C_pair*, Q, CLASS, best D1 control + its D0, best weighted, C-TASK, 5 constrained arms, plus the same-map D0 diagnostics of P* and C-TASK; aliases deduplicated), SRC|U, SRC|RAW-J, E, F, F0. SRC|U is costed (a) with the freeze list + the scored codes (~20; exact, see recommendation) and (b) with all 84 codes (upper bound). Token-only / probability-only diagnostics are scored for the registered same-map pairs only (best D1 fixed-map control + its D0 map, P* + its D0 version, C-TASK + its D0 version: <= 6 codes); every other code scores the primary family only

estimates.d0_recompute_extra_basis: what reusing the admitted cbp audits would have saved: the primary code family of the 27 D0 codes and the 3 references per seed (the token-only and probability-only diagnostics are needed under either choice)
estimates.assessment_basis: per seed: 17 codes x the primary family at the i8o64 cost (+ token (cells only, L4b) / prob diagnostics for 6 codes in the _with_code_diagnostics figure, for all codes in _diagnostics_on_every_code); both sources' five own families; SRC|U composed with 20 codes (freeze list + scored codes; the composed code bank is fitted once per unit and shared across the four composing families by the content memo) or all 84 (upper); E / F / F0 at the five-family source cost plus one cells family each for F / F0
estimates.safety_note: synthetic MLP early stopping converges fast; cbp's synthetic estimate (2.89 CPU-h) against about 2.8 CPU-h measured for its lead's audit stages; the x2 margin is the scheduling budget
